column3: Write down the names of your Income Source Categories in the column "Income Source".  There are examples in the PDF guide if you need inspiration.
Transfer your chosen icons from the icon library on the right to the cells in the "Icon" column. To do this, select the cell with the icon of your
choice, copy it (Ctrl + C), then paste it (Ctrl + V) into the cell next to the Income Category.
If you do not find an icon that fits your category, please feel free to send me a message on Etsy and I'll create it for you! :)
If the category is active (you are actively working to earn it) then check the "Active?" checkbox. Non-checked categories will be considered Passive Income.

Step 3: Set Up Your Bills and Subscriptions
    This section is for recurring bills (Rent, Utilities, ...) and subscription fees (Netflix, Amazon Prime, ...).

Step 4: Set Up Your Debt Payoff

    This section is for your debt payments, such as student loans, mortgages and credit card debt. It should not include your normal monthly
     credit card repayments, as those will be taken into account in the "Bank Accounts & Credit Cards" section below.

column3: Step 1: First, double-click in the Start Date cell to choose from which month you would like to start monitoring your debts. We recommend the same date as the start of the spreadsheet (date format example "Jan 2025").
Step 2: Fill in the Starting Balance, Minimum Payment and Annual Interest for each of your debts.

Step 3: The calculation above the table shows the total minimum payments you will have to make on your debts each month. Next to this, write the amount you actually plan to allocate towards paying off your debts each month under Planned Actual Payment. This amount must be equal or higher than the Minimum Payment
Step 4: Choose between 3 different methods to repay your debts:

column6: - The Snowball Method: Pay off your debts starting with those with the smallest balance first. This method is designed to motivate you as you will be able to see yourself paying off these smaller debts faster.

- The Avalanche Method: Pay off your debts starting with those with higher interest rates first. This method is designed so that you pay less interest overall and reduce the time it takes to pay back your debt.

- Your own Custom Order Method: Select this method if you would like to choose the order in which you pay off your debts, then write the order (starting with 1, 2, ...) in the last column of the table below.

column3: First, fill in your Savings Goal, Start Balance, Start Date and Goal Date. The Start Date should be either the same as the start date of the spreadsheet or later (date format example "Jan 2025").
When adding Start and Goal Dates, you can double-click in the cell to select a date from a pop up calendar.
To copy and paste dates: Use "Ctrl + C" and "Ctrl + V", please do not drag the corner of the cell down as this will produce different dates.
